summary_1line: After cursing King Parikshit, Sringin is rebuked by his father Samika, who warns the king through a messenger; Parikshit repents upon hearing the curse.

image_candidates.scene_text: The young ascetic Sringin angrily declares that the serpent Takshaka will kill King Parikshit in seven days while his father Samika looks on in disapproval.
The sage Samika, calm and austere in the forest hermitage, sternly instructs his son to abandon anger and uphold forgiveness.
In his palace hall, King Parikshit listens gravely as the ascetic messenger Gaurmukha announces the deadly curse before the assembled ministers.
